title: 第7章 冲突升级存音石第8章 族比之日生死台
content_zh:
来者赫然就是叶宇的哥哥——叶青。
在双方刚刚爆发冲突之时就有人前去通知叶青，只不过他终究还是晚来了一步。
眼睁睁的看着自己的亲弟弟被废去左手。
彻骨的杀意让叶青再也无法保持理智。
只见他手中浮现长剑，同时闪身朝叶无尘冲来，一点剑芒朝叶无尘眉心刺去。
然而，面对叶青这暴怒的一剑，叶无尘却是站在原地丝毫没有动作。
眼见叶青的长剑离叶无尘越来越近，众人眼中，叶无尘依旧站在原地没有动弹。
“叶无尘不会是被吓傻了吧。”
“我看他之前能废去叶宇的丹田多半是依靠什么丹药，如今恐怕是遭到了丹药的反噬，无法行动了。”
在场的诸多弟子纷纷开始感叹了起来。
有不屑的、有唏嘘的、有幸灾乐祸的。
在他们看来，叶青此剑丝毫没有留情，叶无尘多半是会被当场斩杀在此地。
然而，就在叶青的长剑离叶无尘眉心只有三寸左右的时候。
一道身影挡在了叶无尘的前方，轻而易举的便抓住了叶青手中的长剑。
“大庭广众之下，谁让你们进行私斗的？”
此时挡在叶无尘身前的，赫然就是叶家的执法长老叶苍。
叶苍，叶家的二长老，被誉为叶家武痴，以铁面无私着称。
叶苍目光看向叶无尘跟叶青两人，沉声开口道：
“叶家家规有明令禁止，家族内禁止私斗，你们是觉得自己可以凌驾在叶家家规之上吗？”
叶青其实并没有失去理智，他本是抱着执法长老还未到来的空档想要趁机诛杀叶无尘。

只可惜，叶苍终究还是及时赶来了。
“长老明察，此事乃是叶无尘率先挑起事端，甚至他还将我弟弟的左手给废了。”
叶青朝叶苍行了一礼，随后走到一旁将叶宇扶起，将一颗丹药喂到了叶宇的口中。
叶苍看向叶宇，又看了看叶无尘，眸光深邃，不知道在想些什么。
“叶宇，将刚刚发生的事情都说出来吧，若真是叶无尘做错了，我定然严惩于他。”
叶苍开口道。
吃过丹药，叶宇的状态已然好多了。
但他的左手依旧耷拉在地面之上，若是没有续骨丹的救治，这条手臂怕是保不住了。
续骨丹，三品丹药，即使是叶青想要获得此丹，估计都得付出极大的代价。
在叶苍的注视下，叶宇一双眼眸愤恨的看向叶无尘，随即将刚刚的事情娓娓道来。
不过他却是选择隐藏了一部分事实，把大部分的过错都归咎于叶无尘身上。
在听到叶无尘一脚将叶宇踢的毫无反抗之力之时。
叶苍那双眼眸直勾勾的看向叶无尘，似乎是要将他看穿一般。
发现叶苍在打量自己，叶无尘毫不畏惧的与其对视。
此时，叶苍心中隐隐有个猜测，叶无尘的修为与眼睛极有可能已经恢复了。
“叶宇此话可还属实？”
待叶宇讲述完毕，叶苍的视线扫过在场的众人，以求证询事实。
只可惜，在场的诸多弟子都知道叶宇所说之话与事实大不相同，但却没有任何一个人站出来为叶无尘说话。
由此便可以看出，叶无尘在这群叶家弟子心中的地位如何。
见到在场的众多弟子没有一个人站出来为叶无尘说话。

叶苍又转头看向一旁的叶古，淡淡开口道，“叶古长老，刚刚叶青所说的，可还属实？”
content_en:
The person who came was surprisingly Ye Yu’s brother, Ye Qing.
When the conflict between the two sides just broke out, someone went to notify Ye Qing, but he came a step too late after all.
He watched helplessly as his own brother was deprived of his left hand.
Ye Qing could no longer maintain his sanity due to his bone-chilling murderous intent.
I saw a long sword emerging from his hand, and at the same time he ducked and rushed towards Ye Wuchen, with a bit of sword light stabbing Ye Wuchen between his eyebrows.
However, facing Ye Qing's furious sword, Ye Wuchen stood there without making any move.
Seeing Ye Qing's long sword getting closer and closer to Ye Wuchen, in the eyes of everyone, Ye Wuchen still stood there without moving.
"Ye Wuchen couldn't have been frightened."
"I think he was able to destroy Ye Yu's Dantian mostly by relying on some kind of elixir. Now I'm afraid it's the backlash from the elixir that makes him unable to act."
Many disciples present began to sigh.
Some are disdainful, some are lamenting, and some are gloating about others' misfortune.
In their opinion, Ye Qing's sword showed no mercy, and Ye Wuchen would probably be killed on the spot.
However, just when Ye Qing's long sword was only about three inches away from Ye Wuchen's eyebrows.
A figure stood in front of Ye Wuchen and easily grabbed the sword in Ye Qing's hand.
"Who asked you to have a private fight in public?"
The person blocking Ye Wuchen at this time was Ye Cang, the law enforcement elder of the Ye family.
Ye Cang, the second elder of the Ye family, is known as the martial arts idiot of the Ye family and is known for his selflessness.
Ye Cang looked at Ye Wuchen and Ye Qing, and said in a deep voice:
"The Ye family rules clearly prohibit private fights within the family. Do you think you can override the Ye family rules?"
Ye Qing actually did not lose his mind. He originally wanted to take advantage of the opportunity before the law enforcement elder arrived to kill Ye Wuchen.
Unfortunately, Ye Cang finally arrived in time.
"The elder clearly noticed that Ye Wuchen was the first to stir up trouble. He even disabled my brother's left hand."
Ye Qing bowed to Ye Cang, then walked aside to help Ye Yu up, and fed a pill into Ye Yu's mouth.
Ye Cang looked at Ye Yu, then at Ye Wuchen, his eyes were deep and he didn't know what he was thinking.
"Ye Yu, tell me everything that happened just now. If Ye Wuchen really did something wrong, I will definitely punish him severely."
Ye Cang said.
After taking the elixir, Ye Yu's condition is much better.
But his left hand was still hanging on the ground. Without the treatment of Bone Renewal Pill, this arm might not be saved.
The bone-continuing elixir is a third-grade elixir. Even if Ye Qing wants to obtain this elixir, he will probably have to pay a huge price.
Under Ye Cang's gaze, Ye Yu looked at Ye Wuchen angrily, and then explained what had just happened.
However, he chose to hide part of the truth and put most of the fault on Ye Wuchen.
When he heard Ye Wuchen kick Ye Yu until he had no resistance.
Ye Cang's eyes looked straight at Ye Wuchen, as if he wanted to see through him.
Finding Ye Cang sizing him up, Ye Wuchen looked at him without fear.
At this time, Ye Cang had a vague guess in his mind that Ye Wuchen's cultivation and eyes had most likely recovered.
"Are Ye Yu's words still true?"
After Ye Yu finished speaking, Ye Cang glanced at everyone present to verify the facts.
It's a pity that many disciples present knew that what Ye Yu said was completely different from the truth, but no one stood up to speak for Ye Wuchen.
From this, we can see what Ye Wuchen's status is in the hearts of this group of Ye family disciples.
None of the many disciples present stood up to speak for Ye Wuchen.
Ye Cang turned to look at Ye Gu who was standing aside, and said calmly, "Elder Ye Gu, what Ye Qing just said is still true?"
